description: Find a permitted report and read current, source-linked body sections.

tools.description: Retrieve exact passages across the permitted knowledge bases for a factual topic without a user-selected document. Search by a short formal name, identifier, or issuer. If results are too broad or historical, refine the topic or select a returned source and read it.
Find reports by title, organization, aliases and summary before recency.
For findings, read current exact sections of one permitted report with Ready-first/Standard fallback, without a separate readiness call.
Search body evidence only within one selected report.
For explicit status questions, check current Ready and Standard body availability for one report.
